message.content:
Cellular polyurethane in rectangular blocks falls under heading 3921 (other plates, sheets, film, foil and strip of plastics), at subheading 3921.13 for cellular polyurethanes.

Within that subheading, 3921.13.11 and 3921.13.15 cover products combined with textiles. Plain foam blocks with no textile component fall to 3921.13.50.

Under that line, the statistical suffix 3921.13.5000 is the "other" category, so the full code is 3921.13.5000.

Rectangular blocks qualify as "plates, sheets" for heading 3921. Their sale to wheelchair manufacturers does not move them into the wheelchair parts heading (8714). Unworked foam blocks are classified by the material they are made of.

{"hts_code": "3921.13.5000", "reason": "Plain rectangular blocks of cellular polyurethane foam, not combined with textiles, are classified as other cellular polyurethane plates, sheets or strip under 3921.13.50 rather than as wheelchair parts."}
